verified_behavior: Paid, complimentary, and administrative-suspension states are independent; suspension denies, otherwise paid or complimentary grants, otherwise the household is paused.
Complimentary revocation leaves paid truth intact, and suspension/release does not mutate billing.
A paused Parent can authenticate only to identity, protected recovery, and Support; Student authentication, sessions, and learning fail closed when effective access disappears.

Atomic idempotent enrollment creates or links one adult and household, creates pending Parent activation, creates any positive number of local-only Students, optionally grants complimentary access, and queues one adult-only GHL projection.
Ambiguous adult identity, cross-account and cross-household scope, sibling access, stale revisions, and replay attempts fail closed in focused integration and browser coverage.
Adult contact links persist the GHL contact and household field, expose a configured deep link to authorized school operators, and reconcile one Parent through a coalesced event without payment data.
Parent recovery remains link-only and generic; Student recovery is an audited adult-authorized one-time flow that revokes Student sessions and never returns a stored plaintext credential.
Signed paid-state intake requires the exact durable adult-contact-to-household link and configured GHL location without requiring an activated Parent.
Existing fictional preview behavior remains isolated with exactly three active fictional Students while normal households permit additional Students.
